problem: The centered response indicator inherited muted gray colors for both its animated dots and agent label.
solution: Added an explicit black response-indicator tone, made TypingIndicatorView accept a caller color, and applied the same black tone to the dots and label. The production build also includes the concurrently referenced HotkeyBar source and limits Swift compiler parallelism to fit available memory.
lesson: Progress feedback should declare its visual tone explicitly instead of inheriting a secondary metadata color. Parameterizing the dot component keeps other call sites independent.
